text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong tells business leaders he is cautiously optimistic growth would be healthy next year and more good years are ahead.
- Singapore Parliament endorses Cost Review committee's report and members of Parliament rap Singapore Democratic Party and Singapore Malay National Organisation for attempting to mislead.
- Singapore's Hong Leong Holdings and Government of Singapore Investment Corp part of consotrium which won tender to develop Hong Kong $9 billion property project.
- Singapore High Court halts proceedings in Singapore $2 billion negligence lawsuit against auditors of Baring Futures and rules London more appropriate forum for it to be heard.
- Turnover value on stock market in October climbs 19.5 percent to Singapore $4.9 billion.
- Business Times and Centre for Business Research & Development survey finds business performance and sentiment weakened sharply in third quarter.
- Kian Ann Engineering initial public offering 30.4 times subscribed.
- Computer giant IBM will double the capacity of its Singapore disk drive plant by 1998.
- Power utility Tenaga Nasional posts sharp 35.8 percent drop in net profit for year ended August 31 to Malaysian $797.8 million.
- Pidemco Land secures large piece of freehold land in Upper Serangoon residential estate for Singapore $56 million.
- Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp will buy out its partners in Singapore Food Industries for nearly Singapore $70 million.
- Parkway Holdings to net over Singapore $1.2 billion from sale of non-health care assets.
